editorial.blurb: A warm, welcoming neighborhood cafe in Lincoln Park that feels like a well-loved local secret, serving exceptional brunch and comfort food with genuine care for every guest.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on Sunday mornings for the best seating and to snag their famous fresh-baked goods before they sell out; the noise level is low enough to actually enjoy conversation, and staff will gladly accommodate kids with water cups and crayons.
